newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil alcohol firms ditch north-east, flock south.
newsitem.headline: Brazil alcohol firms ditch north-east, flock south.

text.p: Sugar and alcohol producers from Brazil's northeast, burdened with high costs and low productivity, are flocking to the southern states in search of land, labor and profit, a local alcohol official said.

These large industries have already relocated to Minas Gerais, Mato Grosso and Goias states, but it is the so-called Triangulo Mineiro region of Minas Gerais that is proving a focal point for fresh investment.
